title: PRISM: Validation-Free Online Batch Selection for LLM Fine-Tuning via Preconditioned Conic Ghost Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.27578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online batch selection lowers the cost of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) by replacing each candidate batch with a smaller informative subset. Existing selectors typically depend on a held-out validation or proxy set, or else rely on Euclidean facility-location objectives over unpreconditioned gradients whose diameter-shifted similarities are distorted by heavy-tailed gradient norms and cross-layer anisotropy. We introduce PRISM (Preconditioned Ray-Isotropic Submodular Matching), a validation-free online batch selector that aligns candidate gradients in a factored second-moment metric and casts subset construction as conic facility location over positive ray projections. Computing the required pairwise geometry through factored preconditioned ghost inner products avoids materializing per-example parameter gradients, while the conic objective remains normalized, nonnegative, and monotone submodular---guaranteeing a $(1-1/e)$ gree

translated_title: PRISM：基于预条件锥形幽灵匹配的大语言模型微调无验证在线批选择
translated_abstract: 在线批选择通过将每个候选批次替换为更小的信息子集，从而降低大语言模型（LLM）微调的成本。现有选择器通常依赖预留的验证集或代理集，否则依赖于未预条件化梯度上的欧几里得设施选址目标，其相似度会因重尾梯度范数和跨层各向异性而失真。我们提出PRISM（Preconditioned Ray-Isotropic Submodular Matching，预条件射线各向同性子模匹配），这是一种无需验证集的在线批选择器，它在分解的二阶矩度量中对齐候选梯度，并将子集构建转化为正射线投影上的锥形设施选址问题。通过分解的预条件幽灵内积计算所需的成对几何结构，避免了逐样本参数梯度的显式构建，同时锥形目标保持归一化、非负且单调子模——保证了 (1-1/e) 的贪心近似（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PRISM提出了一种无需验证集的大语言模型微调在线批选择方法，通过预条件化的锥形幽灵匹配将子集选择建模为归一化的单调子模锥形设施选址问题，避免逐样本梯度显式计算的同时保证 (1-1/e) 的贪心近似效果。
en_tdlr: PRISM is a validation-free online batch selection method for LLM fine-tuning that casts subset construction as normalized, monotone submodular conic facility location over factored preconditioned ghost inner products, avoiding per-example gradient materialization while guaranteeing a (1-1/e) greedy approximation.
